mission_03: Fit a LogisticRegression model with X as features and treatment as the target, then use model.predict_proba(X)[:, 1] to get propensity scores.
Separate treated (treatment==1) and control (treatment==0) indices, then use NearestNeighbors(n_neighbors=1) on control propensity scores to find matches for treated units.
ATT = mean(outcomes[treated] - outcomes[matched_controls]). For balance, compute (mean_treated - mean_control) / sqrt((var_treated + var_control) / 2) for each covariate.
